description_en: Create an application session and start an application process, then return the session information
description_zh: 创建应用会话，并启动一个应用进程，返回会话信息
name: CreateAppSession

parameters.help_en:
Application Version ID.

If you do not specify an active version, the default application uses the latest version
parameters.help_zh:
应用版本ID。

当您未指定生效版本时，默认应用最新版本
parameters.name: app_version

parameters.help_en:
Custom User ID, with a maximum length of 64 characters.  

Used by your business to perform operations based on the user dimension.  

This parameter is Required when the application Type is `end_game` or `hand_game`
parameters.help_zh:
自定义用户ID，最大长度不超过64个字符。

用于业务对用户维度做相应的操作。 

当应用类型为`end_game`、`hand_game`时，本参数必填
parameters.name: custom_user_id

parameters.help_en:
Custom session ID used to ensure idempotence of requests.  

Generate a unique value from your client to guarantee uniqueness across different requests.  

ASCII characters are supported, and the length must not exceed 64 characters
parameters.help_zh:
自定义会话ID，保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: custom_session_id

parameters.help_en: Client IP address of the business, such as the player's IP address in a cloud gaming scenario
parameters.help_zh: 业务的客户端IP，比如云游戏场景中玩家的IP
parameters.name: client_ip

fields.help_en:
Currently supported enumeration values include:
startArgument: Application start parameter
fields.help_zh:
目前支持的枚举值包括：
startArgument：应用启动参数
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value corresponding to the key
fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
Custom key values are supported. The following reserved words are defined by convention:  
utdid: represents the Device ID, which helps the platform analyze features of unusual traffic and locate issues
fields.help_zh:
key取值支持自定义。约定以下保留字：
utdid：表示设备ID，可以帮助平台分析异常流量的特征和定位问题
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value corresponding to the key
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: System information, such as client device model
parameters.help_zh: 系统信息，如客户端侧机型等信息
parameters.name: system_info

parameters.help_en:
Timeout for on-demand resource provisioning in pay-as-you-go mode.  
Value range: [900, 43200] seconds. Default value: 1800
parameters.help_zh:
按量付费模式按需生产资源的超时时间。
取值范围 [900, 43200]秒，默认值1800
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to provision resources on demand when creating a session in pay-as-you-go mode. Valid values:  
true: Yes  
false: No (default)
parameters.help_zh:
按量付费模式下创建会话时，是否按需生产资源。取值范围：
true：是
false：否，默认false
parameters.name: enable_postpaid

parameters.help_en: 项目ID。如果已将应用关联到项目，创建会话时需填写正确的项目ID
parameters.help_zh: 项目ID。如果已将应用关联到项目，创建会话时需填写正确的项目ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: 适配文件ID。此功能灰度开放，如未约定使用请勿传入
parameters.help_zh: 适配文件ID。此功能灰度开放，如未约定使用请勿传入
